messages:
Leah CS: Heads up — Artemis Labs is showing a big token spike during onboarding. Need a quick QBR-friendly summary and mitigation plan. Seen this before?
cost-bot: Alert: account=Artemis Labs usage increased 3.6x over 24h, predicted 7-day burn +420% :warning:
Marco (CSM): Yikes. Any idea what triggered it? Large batch jobs?
Leah CS: They ingested a full customer dataset and kicked off similarity scans + embeddings. Quick snapshot:```24h_total_tokens: 2,150,432
avg_per_call: 43,210
calls: 49
large_jobs: 3```
Priya Finance: If the same pattern continues, runway hits zero in ~9 days. I can run a 30-day forecast but we should assume mitigations first.
Samir Eng: We can propose an immediate mitigation: route heavy embedding ops to a cheaper embedding variant, enable batching and prefix caching. Draft config below:```route: embeddings -> model: tiny-embed-v2
batch_size: 64
cache_prefix: enabled
throttle: 60rps for similarity endpoints```
Marco (CSM): Marco to own customer comms. I'll propose a 7-day throttle + enablement workshop. Need customer-friendly language explaining temporary switch and cost benefits.
Nora Product: For the QBR, we should call out: root cause (bulk ingestion), short-term mitigations (throttle + model swap), long-term recommendations (precompute, quantized ops, quota policies).
Leah CS: Action items: 1) Marco -> message Artemis with proposed plan and get buy-in (ETA: 2pm PT) 2) Samir -> implement routing rule and a rollback plan (ETA: EOD) 3) Priya -> update 30-day spend forecast and mark renewal risk flag (ETA: 4pm) 4) Nora -> add a slide to QBR deck about this incident and steps + impact estimate.
Priya Finance: I'll also add a temporary budget alert (email + slack) at 60% and 90% of their commit so we don't get a surprise.
Samir Eng: Will put a small canary live first and paste logs here once routing is in. Expect minimal latency change.
Marco (CSM): Draft message to Artemis: "We observed unusually high embedding runs after data import. To avoid depletion of your credits we recommend a brief throttling window and switching embeddings to a cost-optimized model while we run an enablement session to optimize queries." Can someone tone it down / approve?
Leah CS: Approved. Add a note offering a short enablement session this week.
cost-bot: Note: auto-logged incident #INC-2023159 for Artemis Labs, severity=medium, auto-assign=Marco (CSM)
Marco (CSM): I'll send to the customer now and follow up in this thread with their response.
Leah CS: :thumbsup: thanks everyone — we'll capture this in the QBR deck and the postmortem checklist.
Marco (CSM): update: customer acknowledged, happy to do throttle + session. They asked if we can temporarily expand credits if needed — I'll loop finance after Priya's forecast.
Priya Finance: Copy. I'll model the temporary cushion and post numbers in the forecast doc link: https://docs.internal/redwood/ar labs/forecast (will paste numbers here after calc).
Leah CS: Great. Closing loop once Samir confirms routing is live.
Samir Eng: Routing is live on canary, perf looks good. Leaving on for 30m before full rollout. Logs: ```canary_ok: true
median_latency_change: +12ms
token_savings_est: ~58% on embedding ops```
Leah CS: Perfect. I'll mark last_message_ts as current time when we finalize. Thanks all.
